basis: Direct human pi0.5 SFT-first request. Protocol owner's completed bounded primary VLRLA audit found no initial pi0.5 RoboTwin SFT optimizer/LR/batch/steps/data/mask specification. The following are our explicit choices from existing official OpenPI/RLinf sources, not claimed VLRLA SFT hyperparameters.

official_sources.reference_config_limit: This example defaults to pi0 and30k, not pi0.5. It must receive a genuine pi0.5 model/dataconfig override; its unchanged title does not prove pi0.5 settings.

model.initializer: official pi05_base; exact asset revision/hash/native loading binding remains pending
model.precision_pattern: official SFT actor.model.precision fp32 with openpi.embed_dtype bf16; preserve native FP32 islands and actual official FSDP semantics
model.required_delta: Drop pi0-only state_projection wrapper/rule because pi0.5 has no state_proj; no fake module or validator bypass.

learning_rate.limit: The chosen20k fit stops before the30k decay endpoint; do not silently retime the scheduler to20k.

fit.checkpoint_policy: Final fixed20k endpoint for both PPO initializers, complete model/Adam/scheduler/sampler/global-private RNG. Source owner binds declared immutable milestones and exact continuation before execution. No random-evaluation checkpoint selection.

data.scope: Six source tasks, clean demonstrations only; exact episode inventory, split and format conversion remain to be verified on allocated Linux.
data.format: Official LeRobot2.1/task prompts and actual ALOHA state/action conventions
data.normalization: Compute from actual clean TRAIN only, preserve official12 arm delta/2 absolute gripper/adapt_to_pi semantics and identical inference mapping. Randomized evaluation data stays excluded.

resources: No SFT allocation/reservation yet. Exact data/initialization/code/validation and measured finite capacity/time/output proposal precede dispatch. First capacity updates belong to this same fixed20k fit and remain resumable, not a disposable benchmark.
not_admitted: No new SFT runtime, weights, model construction, data-array inspection, SGD, robot episode or PPO was executed by this metadata decision. Source owner remains sole implementation writer; execution owner remains sole allocator.
